score_normalization.details: REC is an unweighted expression count with strict IoU > .25 or > .50 and denominator 9508. Box IoU is intersection divided by geometric union. Mask IoU is intersection/union and mIoU is the mean over expressions. Native semantic softmax and whole-range feature normalization are internal model operations, not normalization of accuracy by predictions. CPU float64 IoUs differ numerically from recorded float32 values by at most 1.1152131449865266e-5 at selected boxes, with zero threshold-label changes.
